proposed_capability: Chain current menu observation, authorized save dispatch, active household entry and a distinct installed native responder decision through standard Play.
player_save_control_impact: Reuse existing lab save admission and calibrated menu navigation. Bind household effects to the observed save, lot and unchanged player input generation. Keep upgrade-parts mode and protected saves outside this change.
expected_outcome: One Play invocation observes and selects an authorized save, enters the intended active household, and checks for an independently observed native responder decision.
negative_tests: Wrong save, wrong household, ambiguous active lot, replayed capture, player takeover and missing native decision cannot produce startup success.
rollback_path: Revert the scoped commits. No Windows host or Sims files are changed by offline work.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build Windows implementation and observation of the startup bridge and installed native responder.
